## Become a member

Fill out the form below to join the American Beaver Party and get updates on 
events and campaigns.

```{=html}
<iframe
  src="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/YOUR_FORM_ID/viewform?embedded=true"
  style="border: 0; width: 100%; max-width: 700px; height: 700px; display: block; margin: 0 auto;"
  title="Join the American Beaver Party">
  Loading…
</iframe>
```

*Replace `YOUR_FORM_ID` with your Google Form's ID (Form → Send → `<>` embed tab).*
